name: io.github.denizgursoy/kafka-mcp
title: Kafka MCP
description: Debug Kafka from an agent: find messages, measure consumer lag, unblock consumers, compare clusters.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount your kafka-mcp.yaml into the container, read-only

environmentVariables.name: CONFIG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the mounted configuration is read from inside the container
